research.title: Blackstone on hedge funds: Why multi-strats are back
research.summary: Multi-strategy hedge funds are drawing fresh attention as investors reassess traditional 60/40 portfolios amid higher stock–bond correlations. In this second conversation with Blackstone, Kumar Panja, EMEA head of Capital Advisory Group at J.P. Morgan, sits down with Joe Dowling, global head of Blackstone Multi‑Asset Investing business (BXMA), and Riad Abrahams head of Strategy, Risk and Quant Analytics in BXMA, to unpack what’s driving multi‑strat growth—and how allocators are using these strategies as a potential fixed income substitute.
